name: Encased Fans
description: An Encased Fan turns rotation into an air current.

pages.title: Encased Fans
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A fan blows air, and items in it are processed **in bulk**.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() What the air passes through picks the job: water washes, fire smokes, lava blasts, soul fire haunts.
- Speed changes only the range.
- Smoke food: blasting burns it.

An **Encased Fan** turns rotation into an air current. Items caught in it, on the ground, on a belt or a depot, get [#](7A3C9A)[bulk processed](entry://glossary/bulk_processing)[#]() depending on what the air passes through.\
\
Speed only changes the range, not the processing speed.

pages.title: Encased Fan
pages.text: Direction follows rotation. The air also pushes mobs, players and dropped items.

**Base types**:

- [#](7A3C9A)[Washing](entry://glossary/washing)[#](): air through water

- Smoking: fire or campfire

- Blasting: lava

- [#](7A3C9A)[Haunting](entry://glossary/haunting)[#](): soul fire or soul campfire

Washing: [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]().

A **Blaze Burner** also works as a blasting and smoking source, and the Lit Blaze Burner variant for haunting, see [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().\
\
Bars, fences and leaves let air through; solid blocks stop it.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** blasting works like a furnace and would burn food: smoke it instead.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** **Added by other mods**:

- [#](2E5AAC)[Dragons Plus](entry://industry/dragons_plus)[#](): ending (dragon breath), freezing (powder snow), sanding (quicksand), coloring (liquid dye), enchanting (Golden Aercloud)

- Create Nuclear: enriching

- [#](2E5AAC)[Enchantment Industry](entry://industry/enchanting)[#](): salvaging

pages.title: Enriching Campfire
pages.text: Create Nuclear's [#](7A3C9A)[fan catalyst](entry://glossary/fan_catalyst)[#]() for bulk enriching. Enriched fire comes from Enriched Soul Soil, see [#](2E5AAC)[Nuclear](entry://industry/nuclear)[#]().
